title: Mixed Event — SEKAI Happy New Year! — Episode9 How to Catch a Lion!

meta.Episode: Episode9 — How to Catch a Lion!
meta.Event Outline: Celebrate the New Year with Miku and the others in SEKAI! Get ready for a special episodic story featuring all group members!

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heeelp!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: GROOOAR! CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, Lion Dance Robot's so fast!
I wanna chase it too!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, me too! If you're having a race, let me join!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I think I understand what happened...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The impact from the mallet must've triggered the self-defense mechanism from the Robo-Nene OS, so it now sees Tsukasa as a threat...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
This is an incredible development!
I need to record as much data as I can!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Everyone's having so much fun!
Let me join in too♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You're kicking up clouds of dust.
Could you settle down until we're done here?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nooo! You guys! Hurry up and help meee!!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wh-What do we do, KAITO?
Tsukasa's really in trouble...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes. We should save him...!
But can we really stop that thing...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Stop... Or capture?
Because I've got just the thing in that case!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is that... The giant net you found the other day?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup! I thought we could use it for a sports-themed show or something!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I see. It's big enough to use to catch the Lion Dance Robot.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah☆ We can do it if we work together!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll go and ask Emu and the others to come help too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So our plan is to capture the Lion Dance Robot using a giant net!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A terrific plan.
I did want to capture some more data but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tsukasa's legs might give out soon if we don't help him...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want to help too of course!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone!
Okay, KAITO and Miku will give us the signal and...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Everyone knows what to do, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku, Len, MEIKO, are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup! All good here!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm ready too!
This should be fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay! Let's begin Operation Lion Capture!

rows.Speaker: Len & MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, Miku's team opened the net...
Emu, your turn.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeeeah! I just have to lure the robot into the net, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Easy peasy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yoohoo, Lion Dance Robot! Over heeere!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Come chase me!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hahaha! You're so fast!
But I'm faster! Catch me if you can!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay. All proceeding according to plan.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How did you know the robot would change targets and chase Emu instead?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The lion from the lion dance is traditionally a bringer of happiness and wards off misfortune.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So based on that, it's not unlike Emu.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait. That sounds more like when dogs at a park start playing with each other...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Well, yes. You could put it that way too.
Oh, Nene. It's almost your turn. Ready?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Common sense really doesn't apply to you and Emu... Anyways, I'm ready to fly the drone.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm ready too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, let's raise the net.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Are those... Rui's drones?
Lifting up a huge net...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Emu! Time for the finale!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeeeah! I'm on it!
Running towards the net now☆

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: RAAARGH! CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sorry, Lion Dance Robot!
This is the end of our race!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Neneee, now! Release the net!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Dropping the net on the robot...!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP?!?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Bullseye! Len, hold down the edge of the net so it doesn't escape!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Roger!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nice! They caught it with the net!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We're almost finished.
Nene, the rest is up to you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Lift it up, nice and steady.

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: RAAARGH! CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woooow, it's being airlifted!
Rui's drones are crazy strong!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's a big catch, huh?

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP...!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sorry, but it's time to turn you off.

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP?! CH...OM... P...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Phew... I'm glad you're still in one piece, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thanks for helping me out there!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Tsukasa☆
You must be exhausted after all that running!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I managed to collect some very interesting data too. Now, I just have to analyze it when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, how about showing me some more sympathy? I had an awful time because of your robot, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, we get it. You had a rough time. Can we get back to making mochi already...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do it! I brought soy sauce, sweet soybean powder and matcha, so we can make a bunch of different flavors☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, Emu! Can I have a turn with the mallet?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sure! I'll show you how to do it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I feel like they're treating me worse and worse as time passes...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What a rough way to start the new year, Tsukasa. I'm glad you're okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It really is and I'm glad SOMEONE acknowledges that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: At least you never get bored in this company?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's true!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Boredom doesn't suit a future star like myself!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. There's our usual Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Shall we join the others and make some mochi?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. I'll make mochi with a real bite to it and show off my star power!
